analysis: Consolidated round3 C3-01 route (b): predeclared refined-resolution validation design
declared: 2026-10-29, before any refined-resolution result of stage A or B was available

strata.front: every per-run feasible Pareto point under the production profile, all 160 evaluations
strata.boundary: post-initialization observations whose production classification changes under any combination of sizes and divergences x0.78 or x1, bunch length x0.99 or x1.01, energy -0.05, 0 or +0.05 MeV (C2-12 bounds)
strata.random: two post-initialization observations per run from the remainder, fixed seed

level_selection_rule.tolerance: relative change <= 3 % in each of eps_x, eps_y, sigma_E, sigma_x, sigma_y, sigma_xp, sigma_yp, sigma_z, and <= 0.05 MeV in mean energy, for all ten settings
level_selection_rule.step: H/4 if |fine_step8 - fine| is within tolerance; otherwise H/8 if |fine_step16 - fine_step8| is within tolerance; otherwise H/16, flagged as not shown converged
level_selection_rule.particles: 40k if |fine_p80k - fine| is within tolerance; otherwise 80k, flagged as not shown converged
level_selection_rule.grid: 64 cells if |fine_p80k_grid96 - fine_p80k| is within tolerance; otherwise 96, flagged as not shown converged
level_selection_rule.validation_level: the combination of the selected step, particle count and grid
level_selection_rule.cost_gate: if the estimated stage-B wall time with 20 workers exceeds 3 days, report to the author before launching

stage_b.population: the 704 sample rows at the validation level
endpoints: refined production-profile classification of every sampled point and the flip rate per arm and stratum
refined feasible fraction per arm, estimated by stratum weights over the 1,440 post-initialization evaluations
paired constraint-aware-minus-baseline differences with group-bootstrap intervals
refined per-run fronts and the epsilon and IGD+ indicators against a refined pooled reference

fine_reference_runtime_s.note: measured in C2-12 with eight workers under contention
